LIMIT = 4000   # Telegram refuses messages over 4096 characters, keep a margin

results = []

for item in _items:
    chat_id = item["json"]["chatId"]
    text = item["json"]["text"] or ""

    # cut on line breaks, so a deadline is never split in the middle
    chunk = ""
    for line in text.split("\n"):
        if len(chunk) + len(line) + 1 > LIMIT and chunk != "":
            results.append({"json": {"chatId": chat_id, "text": chunk}})
            chunk = ""
        chunk = chunk + line + "\n"

    if chunk.strip() != "":
        results.append({"json": {"chatId": chat_id, "text": chunk}})

return results
